summary.text: Chip VanHouden is a Republican state representative who has represented District 26 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes working as a sales representative for Harvard MedTech.

paragraphs.text: Chip VanHouden assumed office in the Kansas House on January 13, 2025, succeeding Adam Thomas.
For 2025 and 2026 he is assigned to the Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, General Government Budget, House Local Government, and House Transportation committees.
